auth_fix_verification.root_cause: Race condition where navigate() was called immediately after login/signup API call, but React state hadn't propagated yet. ProtectedRoute saw user as null and redirected back to /login.
fix_applied: 1. login/signup functions now set localStorage FIRST before state changes
2. Login.jsx/Signup.jsx/AuthCallback.jsx use useEffect to watch user state
3. Navigation only happens AFTER user state is confirmed to be set

critical_code_review_comments: The auth fix implementation correctly addresses the race condition by using useEffect to watch state changes before navigation
localStorage is set FIRST before React state, ensuring persistence even if state propagation is delayed
loginAttempted.current ref prevents unwanted navigations on component mount
seed_data_creation: Created test users during signup tests (test_signup_*, test_auth_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Authentication redirect loop bug has been fixed and verified. All auth flows (signup, login, OAuth buttons, protected routes, logout) are working correctly. Dashboard loads properly after authentication. Console shows chart dimension warnings but these are cosmetic issues only.

rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: Authentication redirect loop - new users couldn't access dashboard after signup/login
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Race condition between React state propagation and navigation. navigate('/') was called immediately after login()/signup() returned, but the user state in AuthContext wasn't propagated yet. When ProtectedRoute checked user, it was still null, causing redirect back to /login.
reproduction_steps: 4. User would briefly see dashboard then immediately redirect to /login
rca_of_the_issue.fix_implemented: Changed navigation trigger from immediate (after API call) to reactive (via useEffect watching user state). localStorage is now set FIRST to ensure persistence.
